{{Top|leg}}
'''Spitcrete''' was a primitive building material used to build low load-bearing items such as benches.

In contrast to [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] or [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]], spitcrete was not customarily utilized as a construction material in most civilized portions of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

Jaina Solo and her Jedi companions sat on spitcrete benches while eating in the [[Taat]] valley.

Spitcrete could be used for other tasks, such as primitive heat sinks used on the Killiks Nest Ship.
